name: Princess Charming
source:
(Based on Prince Charming from "Cinderella")

Charming, crown princess of Lunar Kingdom, has led quite a, well, charming life. Independent and adventurous, Charming can more than take care of herself with her impressive magic. Due to her innate magical talent, Charming tends to be rather cocky about her abilities and has developed a hero complex of sorts. She constantly rushes off to save people she deems troubled, although many of them neither want nor need her help.
While Charming has her flaws, it is undeniable that she has a deep sense of responsibility towards her country and people. She has dedicated a lot of time and effort in preparation for queenhood, and she is loved by her people for all she has done for the kingdom.
